---
title: "Meet the Ambassadors"
---

Welcome to the RDA ambassador directory. This page should help visitors understand who is involved, what expertise they bring, and how to connect with the right person.

## What This Directory Should Show

- Name
- Domain or thematic focus
- Institution and country
- Areas of expertise
- Relevant RDA groups, outputs, or activities
- Preferred contact route

## Suggested Filters for a Future Version

- Domain
- Country or region
- Topic or expertise
- Language
- Type of support offered
